primary_head: binary (Normal vs Any-ILD high-recall screening triage)

framing.role: high-recall triage/screening support, not strong overall discrimination or autonomous diagnosis
framing.primary_metric: patient cascade F1 at fixed dual-threshold operating point
framing.co_reported: patch AUC as discriminative-power metric at patch level
framing.decision_theoretic_note: On ~93:7 ILD-prevalent cohort, fixed high-recall dual-threshold rule favors operating-point F1 over ranking; high F1 with near-chance patient MCC/AUC is expected, not a contradiction
framing.no_significance_vs_literature: No formal significance testing vs prior literature (cohorts, tasks, and splits differ)
framing.limitations: Single-center MedGIFT N=113; no external validation; no prospective reader study

training.phase1: Binary-only discriminative fine-tuning (stem/layer1/layer2=1e-6, layer3=1e-5, layer4=3e-5, binary head=1e-4); hier/path heads frozen during CV
training.phase2: Multi-head fine-tuning with binary Softmax head frozen throughout: (a) epochs 1-5 hier+path only (encoder+binary frozen, lr=1e-4); (b) epochs 6-15 layer4 unfrozen (encoder 3e-5, hier/path 1e-4); (c) epochs 16-20 full encoder + hier/path at 1e-5, binary still frozen; safety revert if binary patch F1 < 0.85

cascade.note: Patient-level binary only; voxel pathology maps remain plain argmax of Softmax votes. Primary patient metric is cascade F1 at this fixed rule.

phase1_binary_patch_cv.note: Concatenated OOF patch-level binary F1 with bootstrap 95% CI (1000 iterations). Patch AUC is co-reported as the discriminative-power metric at patch level.

phase1_binary_cascade_cv.note: 5-fold patient-level cascade mean under Phase-1 CV (primary generalization claim = cascade F1 at fixed dual-threshold; cascade_cv_fold_metrics.csv). Near-zero MCC: patient-level ranking of continuous mean lung ILD probability is not claimed.

discriminative_metrics.note: Patch AUC co-reported. Exploratory patient AUC ≈0.58 is near chance on this cohort; ranking ability is not claimed. Patient AUC omitted from primary table.

phase1_binary_cascade_repeated_cv_supple.note: Supplementary 3x5 repeated CV (15 folds); not the paper primary claim

phase1_binary_cascade_best.note: Patient-level cascade on best Phase-1 checkpoint before Phase-2

phase1_secondary_tertiary_patch_cv.note: Patch-level OOF macro-F1 for secondary/tertiary heads. Volumetric biomarkers are deterministic post-processing of these maps and inherit this limited per-class reliability; not independently validated measurements.

phase2.note: Deployed full-cohort Phase-2 checkpoint (binary head frozen; encoder layer4 refinement). Implementation result only — not held-out generalization; primary claim remains 5-fold CV cascade F1 0.839 ± 0.056.
